channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Larry Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Larry Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Richard Hamilton on Larry Brown
item.description:
During the event, he spent much of the day teaching the kids the fundamentals of golf, serving as a coach in a way that was quite different from Larry Brown's coaching methods.

“I'm not like Larry Brown yelling and screaming at all the kids,”

Richard Hamilton on Larry Brown, Jul 24, 2026. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Penny Hardaway on Larry Brown
item.description:
Memphis head men's basketball coach Penny Hardaway said.

“Having Coach Brown as part of our program over the last year-and-a-half was very impactful on our student-athletes and me as a coach, and we hope all the best for him and good health moving forward.”

Penny Hardaway on Larry Brown, Dec 9, 2022. Source: University of Memphis Athletics.

item.title: Rasheed Wallace on Larry Brown
item.description:
“I am extremely eager to work with the young men on the team, and I'm excited to cross paths again with Coach Brown and work with Coach (Cody) Toppert.”

Rasheed Wallace on Larry Brown, Aug 26, 2021. Source: University of Memphis Athletics.

item.title: Allen Iverson on Larry Brown
item.description:
Brian Seltzer:Iverson on Larry Brown:

“Once I started to listen to him the way I was supposed to, that’s when I became an MVP.”

Allen Iverson on Larry Brown, Sep 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @brianseltzer.

item.title: RC Buford on Gregg Popovich, Larry Brown
item.description:
“It’s been built to fit the strengths of our teams. [Popovich and I] grew up under Coach Brown, and Larry thinks there’s a wino on the street with a perfect out-of-bounds play. He’ll listen to anybody. And I think we grew up under that burden.”

RC Buford on Gregg Popovich, Larry Brown, Jun 22, 2014. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Tayshaun Prince on Larry Brown
item.description:
“Coach would always ask Lindsey ... whether Coach Brown thought it was the right idea or the wrong idea, he just wanted to hear it from his perspective because Lindsey got so much knowledge. He played the game that long and had been through so many things.”

Tayshaun Prince on Larry Brown, Jan 22, 2013. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Larry Brown
item.description:
The 70-year-old Brown, whose 1,327 victories in the ABA and NBA are eight shy of matching Don Nelson for the most all-time, didn't immediately return a message Sunday seeking comment.

“You can't blame Coach Brown because we have to play the games,”

Stephen Jackson on Larry Brown, Jan 10, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Paul Silas on Larry Brown
item.description:
“Do you want that team to do well? Quite honestly, no! I understand, but I hope to talk to him soon.”

Paul Silas on Larry Brown, Dec 31, 2010. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Larry Brown
item.description:
Charlotte Bobcats Chairman and CEOMichael Jordan announced today that Larry Brown is stepping down as head coach of the team,effective immediately.

“I met with Coach Brown two weeks ago about the team’s performance and what we could do to improve it. We met again this morning after practice. The team has clearly not lived up to either of our expectations and we both agreed that a change was necessary,”

Michael Jordan on Larry Brown, Dec 22, 2010. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Byron Scott on Pat Riley, Larry Brown
item.description:
“I'm lucky enough to played for two of the best coaches ever in Pat Riley and Larry Brown,”

Byron Scott on Pat Riley, Larry Brown, Sep 27, 2010. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.
